answer_1.quote: We introduce InsightAgent, the first automated system capable of generating high-quality systematic reviews... We comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of InsightAgent using 15 existing systematic reviews in the biomedical domain with 9 domain experts and medical students.
answer_1.outputs: Systematic review reports (summaries) with citations and provenance trees

answer_4.quote: We invite 9 medical experts with prior experience in publishing systematic reviews to participate in the evaluation... We use a rubricbased method in which each generated report is independently scored by two experts on multiple dimensions, such as comprehensiveness and writing quality, totaling 100 points.
answer_4.guideline: Rubric-based evaluation by two experts per review, plus a Likert questionnaire covering usability and trustworthiness.
criteria: ability to guide or correct agents
